name: 36619 · Mobile, AL
findings: ZIP 36619 (Mobile) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36619 (Mobile) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36619 (Mobile) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
